recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-30254 unless BR&R later makes a new decision to rename or remodel the element.
issue_request: FHIR-30254 was a Published/Persuasive R5 BR&R change request to add PackagedProductDefinition.containedItemQuantity as a repeatable Quantity for aggregate pack-size counts such as 28 tablets or combination packs with multiple item forms.
initial_application: Commit 7f3a7dfec449e39bde17847bac1373f249509123 added PackagedProductDefinition.containedItemQuantity to source/packagedproductdefinition/structuredefinition-PackagedProductDefinition.xml as Quantity 0..*. Later commits, including c58270261982846561c4e2c2a7612e2b1f660b55 and 1cc9bc245ba957d9601e383e3261ffa201a03ee2, refined the definition and cross-references without removing the element.
additional_context: PackagedProductDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Related Published issue FHIR-31797 clarified containedItemQuantity semantics and repeat usage, while FHIR-39128 considered renaming but resolved to retain the name and add cross-references to packaging.containedItem.amount. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting decision for FHIR-30254.
reconciliation: No source change was necessary because source/packagedproductdefinition/structuredefinition-PackagedProductDefinition.xml already defines PackagedProductDefinition.containedItemQuantity with min 0, max *, type Quantity, isSummary true, and explanatory text for aggregate pack-size use plus distinct repeat units.
